title: spec: rule the submitBehavior.url semantics — objectui#4190 dead-ends on it
body:
Part of objectstack-ai/objectui#4190 (cross-seat transfer per protocol; ruled 2026-08-11 that the exit belongs to the spec seat).

objectui's `FormPage.tsx:574` performs a verbatim redirect on `submitBehavior.url`. What the key MAY carry (relative path? absolute? template variables? which are escaped?) is not ruled anywhere in `packages/spec`, so the consumer cannot be hardened without guessing the contract.

Decision needed: the accepted shape and interpolation semantics of `submitBehavior.url` (and whether a verbatim redirect is the intended consumption). objectui#4190 waits on this ruling; consumer-side work is scoped after it.

Four-lens note for the ruling: prefer the narrowest shape with measured pull — widen later iff demand appears.

Filed by the triage seat Routine (#5474 pilot) recording a maintainer ruling of 2026-08-11. **Unassigned — recording, not claiming.**
